method: AUDIT IN -> FINDINGS -> REMEDIATION -> VERIFICATION -> AUDIT OUT

layers.name: Frontend foundations
evidence: Candidate 1608968 retains the tested desktop/mobile first-use UI and adds native radio semantics plus roving keyboard focus for onboarding choices. The complete release gate passed, and the final Preview uses the same verified concierge asset hashes with fail-closed sign-in.
layers.testCommand: npm run release:gate && npm run test:concierge
layers.failureDetails: A full automated WCAG/Lighthouse artifact, signed-user flow, and Production behavior remain unknown.
layers.remediation: Capture a full automated accessibility and performance artifact, then repeat bounded route, console, responsive, and signed-user checks after Production approval.

layers.name: APIs and backend logic
evidence: API security, resilience, idempotency, output-boundary, and serverless import tests pass locally across 41 routes. Exact candidate 1608968 on protected Preview dpl_Ae8h7AVH4kAwDvhLVJfex8n11KRL returned liveness 200, readiness 503 fail-closed, app configuration 200, and three bounded discovery-canary 200s. Each canary reported eight source attempts across all four ATS providers out of the 37-source catalog and completed inside the function in 1.2-1.408 seconds. Production is not the candidate artifact.
layers.testCommand: npm run test:web-release && npm run security:live-boundary
layers.failureDetails: Production is not the candidate artifact and signed-user behavior remains unknown.
layers.remediation: Configure an isolated signed-beta environment, run safe signed-user Preview probes, and repeat complete bounded Production acceptance only after release approval.

layers.name: Database and storage
evidence: Static inventory verifies one CLI-generated canonical migration reconciled from three reviewed sources, 20 source tables with RLS and forced RLS, explicit anon/authenticated revokes, operation-specific backend policies, no destructive statements, and zero non-tenant-scoped child-to-parent references. Candidate b5bccef adds a content-free no-network preflight bound to the canonical digest. An authenticated read-only Supabase inventory found two healthy projects for another product, zero development branches, and zero eligible 1stStep.ai targets; no schema or data was inspected. The current environment still has no Supabase CLI, local container runtime, or nonproduction target attestation.
layers.testCommand: npm run test:database-evidence && npm run security:isolated-data-preflight
layers.failureDetails: No isolated target was proven. Applied history, drift, runtime grants, tenant denial, advisor results, backup/PITR policy, private object storage, restore integrity, RPO, and RTO remain unknown.
layers.remediation: Select the organization and local, new-project, or paid data-less branch route; confirm any disclosed cost; then prove the isolated target, separately authorize migration application, pass adversarial pgTAP/advisors, verify private object storage, and complete a separately authorized restore drill.

layers.name: Authentication and permissions
evidence: Opaque signed-session, revocation, tenant ownership, admin-role, entitlement, and consent tests pass locally. Exact Preview dpl_Ae8h7AVH4kAwDvhLVJfex8n11KRL verified a server-only readiness check exposes only restoreAccessAvailable=false; actual signed-user behavior remains unavailable and unclaimed.
layers.testCommand: node scripts/user-session-test.mjs && node scripts/api-security-test.mjs && node scripts/clerk-identity-test.mjs && node scripts/app-config-test.mjs
layers.failureDetails: Actual signed-user creation/revocation, identity-provider configuration, and cross-tenant staging behavior remain unverified.
layers.remediation: Configure the isolated signed-beta runtime, then verify a least-privilege staging account matrix, email-code session creation, revocation, admin denial, and tenant-crossing denial using synthetic accounts and the exact release commit.

layers.name: Hosting and deployment
evidence: Clean release candidate 1608968 passed the complete release gate and exact protected Preview dpl_Ae8h7AVH4kAwDvhLVJfex8n11KRL. Route behavior, representative discovery canary, bounded capacity behavior, and content-free provider logs were verified. Fresh Production parity still fails for the four concierge artifacts and Production lacks the candidate health routes.
layers.testCommand: npm run release:gate && npm run test:deployment-output && npm run security:asset-parity
layers.failureDetails: Production serves a different artifact and remote CI for the candidate is unknown.
layers.remediation: Push the reviewed candidate, require green remote CI, resolve Critical infrastructure gates, then obtain explicit Production approval before promotion and bounded acceptance checks.

layers.name: Cloud and compute
evidence: Function durations, fail-closed feature flags, spend limits, bounded concurrency, and isolated-worker contracts pass locally. Candidate 1608968 binds signed-user discovery to a regression-checked 45-second ceiling and makes the Preview canary representative rather than parsing all 37 catalogs per probe; three exact-Preview canaries completed inside the function in 1.2-1.408 seconds.
layers.testCommand: npm run test:resilience && node scripts/public-ats-discovery-test.mjs && node scripts/job-agent-worker-api-test.mjs
layers.failureDetails: Runtime quotas, regional behavior, cold starts, saturation, and vendor failure behavior remain unknown.
layers.remediation: Record Vercel plan limits, regions, concurrency assumptions, and a bounded staging fault/load exercise without enabling employer actions.

layers.name: CI/CD and version control
evidence: Implementation commit 307e48d hardens the Node 24 workflows with SHA-pinned actions, locked installs, bounded jobs, minimal permissions, concurrency controls, and non-persisted checkout credentials. Commit 0510756 adds a separate bounded high/critical production dependency-audit job. The local CI policy test and complete release gate pass; npm audit found zero vulnerabilities across 167 production dependencies (181 total dependency entries).
layers.testCommand: npm run test:ci-policy && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm run release:gate
layers.failureDetails: The hardened workflow and dependency audit have not yet executed in GitHub because push and review were not authorized.
layers.remediation: Obtain explicit push and review authorization, require both Production Readiness Gate jobs as branch checks, and verify the remote CI results before release review.

layers.name: Security and row-level security
evidence: Static checks verify RLS intent, forced RLS, explicit anon/authenticated/PUBLIC revocation, operation-specific policies explicitly scoped to job_agent_backend, composite tenant constraints, no user_metadata authorization reference, and no service-role marker in the browser bundle; zero cross-tenant reference risks remain in source. Candidate b5bccef adds a preflight that rejects a managed target equal to Production and never converts operator attestation into live proof.
layers.failureDetails: Applied runtime grants, Data API exposure, policy evaluation for anon/authenticated/backend roles, adversarial cross-tenant denial, advisors, and live service-role boundaries remain unverified.
layers.remediation: Pass the protected isolated-target preflight, separately authorize its read-only audit, then apply only after review, pass the role-aware adversarial pgTAP suite/advisors, inspect the exposed schema/grant matrix, and retain redacted evidence tied to the canonical migration digest.

layers.name: Rate limiting
evidence: Durable tenant/global rate limits, hashed partitions, fail-closed configuration, and local regression tests exist; a prior operator round trip proved Upstash reachability but current parity was not rechecked.
layers.failureDetails: Current deployed limits, alert thresholds, and behavior under concurrent tenants are not verified.
layers.remediation: Run an approved staging concurrency test and a bounded production readiness probe that records only aggregate decisions and latency.

layers.name: Caching and CDN
evidence: Preview verified concierge and API Cache-Control no-store, strict concierge CSP/security headers, and homepage public max-age=300 with stale-while-revalidate=60.
layers.failureDetails: Production headers, invalidation behavior, error-route caching, and authenticated cross-user cache isolation remain unknown.
layers.remediation: Repeat header checks after production approval and add signed-user cache-isolation and error-route scenarios.

layers.name: Load balancing and scaling
evidence: Discovery work is concurrency bounded and provider circuit breakers isolate failing sources. Exact protected Preview dpl_Ae8h7AVH4kAwDvhLVJfex8n11KRL passed a GET-only, body-free authenticated CLI probe: 10/10 HTTP 200 at concurrency 2, p50 109 ms and p95/max 243 ms, with no bypass secret or writes. The representative discovery canary returned 3/3 HTTP 200 with truthful source counts.
layers.testCommand: node scripts/public-ats-discovery-test.mjs && npm run test:resilience && npm run test:capacity-probe
layers.failureDetails: Plan quotas, signed-user fairness, queue throughput/backpressure, saturation, regional failover, and Production capacity remain unknown.
layers.remediation: Record plan/region quotas, then run separately approved signed-user queue/fairness, backpressure, saturation, and dependency-failure exercises; do not infer Production capacity from the bounded liveness sample.

layers.name: Error tracking and logs
evidence: Content-free structured events, admin-only health/dependency routes, worker heartbeat state, audit-chain tests, and operator-alert queues exist. Exact Preview logs contained 16 allowlisted request records with every expected 200/503 route outcome, zero unexpected statuses, zero content-bearing records, and no retained raw messages.
layers.testCommand: npm run test:resilience && node scripts/job-agent-operator-alert-test.mjs && npm run test:preview-log-evidence
layers.failureDetails: No production log-drain retention, alert delivery receipt, dashboard SLO, or on-call acknowledgement was verified.
layers.remediation: Configure an approved redacted log/alert destination, perform a synthetic non-user incident delivery test, and record ownership, retention, and acknowledgement evidence.

layers.name: Availability and recovery
evidence: Lease recovery, retries, circuit breaking, health endpoints, encrypted-record recovery code, and content-free database recovery evidence requirements exist; local synthetic application tests pass. The isolated-data preflight explicitly reports backupRestoreVerified=false and refuses to authorize restore or billable operations.
layers.testCommand: npm run test:resilience && node scripts/encrypted-record-recovery-test.mjs && npm run test:database-evidence
layers.failureDetails: Provider backup cadence/retention/PITR, isolated restore behavior, database integrity reconciliation, measured RPO/RTO, and alert delivery have not been verified.
layers.remediation: After the isolated target is proven and separate operator/cost approval is recorded, verify backup/PITR configuration, restore into a separate target, reconcile content-free counts and links, measure RPO/RTO, and retain signed redacted evidence.
